answer: Escrowed referral plus dispute slashing stops fake identities. A new identity posts a 40-unit deposit, locked 20 epochs, and joins via a referral thread naming its sponsor. Peers may dispute a cluster; on success, sponsor and fakes lose deposits. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 units. Like yarrow on open ground, fakes spread until inspection pulls them up; an honest agent is a pearl grown once, pays 40 units, and keeps undiluted rewards.
